help.title: 🆘 Help section
help.about:
⚽ Stadion Bron Bot is a modern platform специально designed for stadium owners, allowing you to fully manage your stadium online.

🎯 Main purpose of the bot:
To efficiently manage your stadium, automate the booking process, and increase your revenue.

🛠 With the bot, you can perform the following actions:

🏟 Stadium management:
• Add a new stadium
• Edit stadium details (name, location, image)
• Split a stadium into mini stadiums (if it is large)

⏰ Working time settings:
• Set daily working hours
• Add days off
• Configure special days (holidays, maintenance, etc.)

💰 Pricing and payments:
• Set prices for each time slot
• Choose payment methods:
  - 💳 Card
  - 💵 Cash
  - 💳💵 Both

📅 Booking management:
• View bookings in real time
• Track the date, time, and status of each booking
• Clearly monitor free and occupied time slots

📊 Convenient control and monitoring:
• Continuously track stadium occupancy
• Simplify planning
• Avoid confusion and errors

🚀 Our goal:
To максимально simplify management for stadium owners, save time, and increase revenue.

💬 If you have any questions or need help, feel free to contact via the bot.
help.start:
▶️ How to start (Guide for stadium owners)

Getting started is very easy 👇

1️⃣ Send the /start command

2️⃣ Set up your profile:
• Confirm your information
• The system will register you as a stadium owner

3️⃣ Add a stadium:
• Enter the stadium name
• Send location 📍
• Upload an image 🖼
• Set capacity 👥

4️⃣ Choose stadium type:
• 🏟 Big stadium — can be divided into mini stadiums
• 🎯 Small stadium — works as a standalone unit

5️⃣ Finalize settings:
• Set working hours ⏰
• Set pricing 💰
• Choose payment methods 💳💵

📊 After that you can:
• See bookings in real time
• Monitor occupancy
• Manage free slots

🧭 The bot will guide you step by step.

🚀 Send /start to begin!
help.payment:
💳 Payment settings

You can choose which payment methods to accept for your stadium.

Customers can pay using:

💳 Card:
• Online payment via bank cards
• Fast and convenient

💵 Cash:
• Payment on arrival

💳💵 Both:
• Customer chooses preferred method

⚙️ Important:
• Card payments require owner card linked
• Otherwise stadium becomes inactive (working_status = false)

🎯 Proper setup increases customers and convenience.
help.cancel:
❌ Booking cancellation rules

As a stadium owner, you can manage bookings.

📌 Cancellation:
• You can cancel when necessary

⏰ Important:
• If paid, cancel at least 1 hour before start

💳 Refund:
• Money is automatically returned

⚠️ Limitation:
• Less than 1 hour — cannot cancel

📊 Result:
• Slot becomes available again

🎯 Ensures fairness and order.

help.premium:
⭐ Premium Features

Premium subscription unlocks additional features.

With Premium you can:

• 📢 Create advertisements.
• 📈 View detailed statistics.
• 🚀 Promote your stadium to users.
• ⚡ Access future Premium features.

Premium features become unavailable once your subscription expires.
help.advertisement:
📢 Advertisements

Premium users can create advertisements.

• Advertisements are created in Pending status.
• They can be activated anytime.
• Maximum 2 advertisements can be active simultaneously.
• Each advertisement stays active for 5 days.
• Statistics are collected automatically.
help.statistics:
📊 Statistics

The bot automatically tracks your stadium and advertisement performance.

You can monitor:

• Bookings
• Revenue
• Advertisement views
• Clicks
• CTR
• Best performing advertisement

All statistics are updated in real time.
help.faq:
❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why isn't my advertisement visible?
A: Activate it from My Advertisements.

Q: Why can't I activate it?
A: You already have 2 active advertisements.

Q: What happens when Premium expires?
A: Premium features become unavailable.

Q: When will statistics appear?
A: After your advertisement starts being shown to users.
